title: Buchanan Westerners Riding Club
specs: Over 70 years providing an outdoor equine show facility to youth, families, 4-H members, high school equestrian teams, and disabled individuals.

Under the Michigan equine activity liability act, an equine professional is not liable for an injury to or the death of a participant in an equine activity resulting from an inherent risk of the equine activity.
gap: No pricing information for events or memberships
blurb: The club offers local equine events for competitors of all ages and abilities to begin and expand their showing careers. It supports horseback riding activities through open horse shows, high school equestrian teams, 4-H youth activities, and handicap horseback riding via the We Can Ride 4-H Club. The organization is nonprofit and run solely by its membership.
extraNote: Animal abuse of any kind will not be tolerated; membership privileges may be revoked for involvement in animal neglect or abuse. · April through September
